summary: Tested new 'Tự động quét truyện mới' feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases in test_auto_scan.py pass — new settings fields (auto_scan_enabled/interval/pages/chapter_limit) exist with correct defaults, PUT persists, GET /api/crawl/status returns auto_scan object without next_run_ts, POST /api/crawl/scan-new starts scan + logs 'Quét truyện mới: phát hiện N truyện mới' within 40s, next_run populates within ~24s when enabled, existing chapter_limit-throttled novel shows total_chapters==chapter_limit and site_chapters>full TOC, regression endpoints OK. Frontend: AutoScanCard on Dashboard shows badge (TẮT→ĐANG BẬT), info line and Scan-now button — toast 'Bắt đầu quét truyện mới' fires. SettingsPanel has auto-scan-settings section with switch + 3 inputs + save button; changing them and saving persists after reload; Dashboard badge updates to 'ĐANG BẬT'. Settings restored to defaults (auto_scan_enabled=false, chapter_limit=0, auto_scan_pages=3, auto_scan_interval_min=60).
critical_code_review_comments: crawler.get_settings inserts default doc with `id: 'settings'` but returns it including id — harmless. Settings model doesn't validate min/max ranges (e.g., auto_scan_interval_min<5 is silently clamped only in worker); UI clamps to >=5. Consider server-side validation via Pydantic Field(ge=5).

server.py PUT /api/settings only stores keys the client sends. If a client PUTs only auto_scan_enabled, other defaults are preserved (fine). But there's no auth on any endpoint — acceptable per requirements but noted.
crawler._auto_scan_loop uses time.time()-based next_run_ts with 15s tick; acceptable but drifts a few seconds — fine for MVP.
SettingsPanel save() sends Math.max(5, ...) clamp for interval, which silently overwrites low user inputs without visual feedback. Consider a helper text or validation message.
AutoScanCard uses new Date(iso).toLocaleString('vi-VN'); for null last_run shows em dash — good.
seed_data_creation: None - reused existing novels. Temporarily toggled auto_scan settings during tests then restored to defaults (false/0/3/60).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_auto_scan.py cover the auto-scan feature comprehensively. Site rate-limits chapter crawling via Turnstile; do NOT expect new-novel chapter counts to grow during a test window. The 400 'Đang quét truyện mới rồi' conflict is race-condition dependent — treated as best-effort. wtr-lab.com page fetch takes ~5s per page so scan-new completes in ~10-20s for 2 pages.
